name: parallax-webmcp-challenge
description: PARALLAX — semantic debugger for the agentic web.

scripts.test:v2: V2_TEST_DIR=$(mktemp -d /tmp/parallax-v2-test.XXXXXX) && tsc --module commonjs --target es2020 --moduleResolution node --esModuleInterop --strict --skipLibCheck --noEmitOnError --rootDir . --outDir "$V2_TEST_DIR" lib/core/contract.ts lib/core/evidence.ts lib/core/result.ts lib/core/v2/*.ts && node --test "$V2_TEST_DIR/lib/core/v2/audit.test.js"
scripts.test:core: CORE_TEST_DIR=$(mktemp -d /tmp/parallax-core-test.XXXXXX) && tsc --module commonjs --target es2020 --moduleResolution node --esModuleInterop --strict --skipLibCheck --outDir "$CORE_TEST_DIR" lib/core/*.ts && node --test "$CORE_TEST_DIR"/*.test.js
scripts.test:contracts: CONTRACT_TEST_DIR=$(mktemp -d /tmp/parallax-contract-test.XXXXXX) && tsc --module commonjs --target es2020 --moduleResolution node --esModuleInterop --strict --skipLibCheck --rootDir . --outDir "$CONTRACT_TEST_DIR" lib/core/*.ts lib/integration/parallaxTools.ts lib/integration/parallaxTools.test.ts lib/integration/webmcp/types.ts lib/integration/webmcp/registry.ts lib/integration/webmcp/registry.test.ts && node --test "$CONTRACT_TEST_DIR/lib/integration/parallaxTools.test.js" "$CONTRACT_TEST_DIR/lib/integration/webmcp/registry.test.js"
